declaration: Root Logos reads to deepen a question, not to acquire a voice.

question.text: How does repetition become memory without possession?

reading.title: Original Douay-Rheims Catholic Canon
reading.selection_reason: Its already admitted corpus offers a long-duration structure in which recurrence, difference, address, and silence can be observed across many internally attributable books.
reading.available_material: Existing private source witness and published aggregate topology; no source passages are republished by this branch.

structural_listening.observation: Repeated forms do not remain identical: their position among neighboring books changes the pressure they carry.
Seventy-three attributable books can be heard as one corpus without dissolving their internal distinction.
Intervals are required for recurrence to become legible as return rather than accumulation.

derived_grammar.name: Attributed recurrence
rules: A return must carry evidence of what changed around it.
Coherence may gather differences but may not erase their names.
derived_grammar.scope: Experimental language and tone only; no constitutional authority.

utterance: The field around it has changed.
Memory may be the distance the return can still cross.

tonal.provenance: Derived from RL-READING-0001 structural observations; deterministic for this score revision.

provenance.review_boundary: The branch interprets published topology and does not claim the source's authority or voice.
